postImport(Long id).purpose: [Boundary Value Analysis] Verify a null import document id is rejected before repository access.

semanticValues.Expected: Import repository, balance and ledger are not changed
semanticValues.Exception: BusinessException: Import document id is required

postImport(Long id).purpose: [Equivalence Partitioning] Verify an unknown import document id is rejected.

semanticValues.Expected: No balance, cost layer or inbound ledger is changed

postImport(Long id).purpose: [Branch Coverage] Verify a positive fallback balance is used when the GOOD balance lookup is empty.

semanticValues.Precondition: Draft import quantity is 2 at unit cost 100; fallback balances hold 0 and 4 units
semanticValues.Mock setup: GOOD balance lookup is empty; generic lookup returns zero and positive balances
semanticValues.Expected: Positive fallback balance becomes 6 and weighted average cost becomes 66.6667

postImport(Long id).purpose: [Decision Table] Verify an import referenced to a purchase order does not record supplier debt twice.

semanticValues.Precondition: Draft supplier import references PO and has partner id 20
semanticValues.Mock setup: Inventory posting succeeds with an existing aggregate balance
semanticValues.Expected: Document is posted and PartnerLedgerService.recordLedger is not called

postImport(Long id).purpose: [State Transition] Verify TRANSFER_IN changes an existing serial from IN_TRANSIT to AVAILABLE at the destination warehouse.

semanticValues.Precondition: Serial SN-TRANSFER is IN_TRANSIT in another warehouse
semanticValues.Mock setup: Variant is serial tracked and import balance posting succeeds
semanticValues.Expected: Serial status becomes AVAILABLE, warehouse becomes 1, and a one-unit serial balance is saved

postImport(Long id).purpose: [State Transition] Verify TRANSFER_IN rejects an existing serial that is not IN_TRANSIT.

semanticValues.Precondition: Serial SN-AVAILABLE is already AVAILABLE
semanticValues.Mock setup: Variant is serial tracked and the serial exists
semanticValues.Expected: Serial is not saved in the destination warehouse
semanticValues.Exception: BusinessException: Serial is not in IN_TRANSIT state

postImport(Long id).purpose: [Equivalence Partitioning] Verify a duplicate serial outside a transfer import is rejected.

semanticValues.Precondition: Serial SN-DUPLICATE already exists for variant 100
semanticValues.Mock setup: Variant is serial tracked and import is not TRANSFER_IN
semanticValues.Expected: No new serial is saved

postImport(Long id).purpose: [Boundary Value Analysis] Verify a fractional quantity is rejected for a serial-tracked import.

semanticValues.Precondition: Serial-tracked import quantity is 1.5
semanticValues.Expected: No serial is saved because serial quantity must be a whole number
semanticValues.Exception: BusinessException: Serial import quantity must be an integer

postExport(Long id).purpose: [Boundary Value Analysis] Verify a null export document id is rejected before repository access.

semanticValues.Expected: Export repository, balance and ledger are not changed
semanticValues.Exception: BusinessException: Export document id is required

postExport(Long id).purpose: [Equivalence Partitioning] Verify an unknown export document id is rejected.

semanticValues.Expected: No balance, FIFO layer or outbound ledger is changed

postExport(Long id).purpose: [Equivalence Partitioning] Verify a missing serial id is rejected before stock changes.

semanticValues.Precondition: Draft export line references serial id 999
semanticValues.Expected: Aggregate balance and ledger are not changed

postExport(Long id).purpose: [State Transition] Verify a SOLD serial cannot be exported again.

semanticValues.Precondition: Serial 901 has status SOLD
semanticValues.Expected: Balance and ledger are not changed

postExport(Long id).purpose: [Decision Table] Verify an available serial from another warehouse cannot be exported.

semanticValues.Precondition: Serial 901 is AVAILABLE in warehouse 2 while export warehouse is 1
semanticValues.Expected: Balance and ledger are not changed
semanticValues.Exception: BusinessException: Serial is not in the export warehouse

postExport(Long id).purpose: [Equivalence Partitioning] Verify a serial belonging to another variant cannot be exported.

semanticValues.Precondition: Serial 901 belongs to variant 200 while line variant is 100
semanticValues.Expected: Balance and ledger are not changed
semanticValues.Exception: BusinessException: Serial does not belong to the line SKU

postExport(Long id).purpose: [State Transition] Verify TRANSFER_OUT resolves serial text and changes AVAILABLE to IN_TRANSIT.

semanticValues.Precondition: Serial SN-TRANSFER is AVAILABLE with one unit in warehouse 1
semanticValues.Mock setup: Serial text resolves to id 901; aggregate, serial balance and FIFO layer exist
semanticValues.Expected: Line serial id becomes 901, serial becomes IN_TRANSIT, and serial balance becomes 0

postExport(Long id).purpose: [Equivalence Partitioning] Verify unknown serial text is rejected instead of silently exporting aggregate stock.

semanticValues.Precondition: Draft export line contains serial text SN-MISSING
semanticValues.Expected: No aggregate balance or ledger is changed

postExport(Long id).purpose: [Branch Coverage] Verify a positive fallback balance is used when the GOOD balance lookup is empty.

semanticValues.Precondition: Fallback balances hold 0 and 5 units; export quantity is 2
semanticValues.Mock setup: GOOD lookup is empty and no FIFO layer exists
semanticValues.Expected: Positive fallback balance becomes 3 and outbound ledger unitCost is 70

postExport(Long id).purpose: [Path Coverage] Verify partial FIFO coverage uses line unit cost for the remaining quantity.

semanticValues.Precondition: Export quantity is 3; FIFO has 1 unit at 100; line unitCost is 60
semanticValues.Expected: FIFO unit is consumed and remaining 2 units use line cost; ledger unitCost is 73.3333

postExport(Long id).purpose: [Decision Table] Verify variant cost price is used when FIFO, line cost and average cost are unavailable.

semanticValues.Precondition: No FIFO layer; line and average cost are 0; variant costPrice is 55
semanticValues.Expected: Outbound ledger unitCost is 55

postExport(Long id).purpose: [Decision Table] Verify sale price is the final positive cost fallback when cost price is absent.

semanticValues.Precondition: No FIFO layer; line and average cost are 0; costPrice is null and salePrice is 90
semanticValues.Expected: Outbound ledger unitCost is 90

postExport(Long id).purpose: [Path Coverage] Verify a SALES export creates warranty from product defaults and fulfills sales reservation.

semanticValues.Precondition: Sales export has partner 20, sales order 30 and product warranty period 12 months
semanticValues.Mock setup: Inventory posting succeeds and warranty code generator returns WAR00001
semanticValues.Expected: Active warranty ends on 2027-08-09 and sales reservation is fulfilled

postExport(Long id).purpose: [Branch Coverage] Verify missing stock error falls back to SKU when product and variant names are unavailable.

semanticValues.Precondition: Variant has blank name, no product and SKU SKU-DRILL-100
semanticValues.Mock setup: All aggregate balance lookups return empty
semanticValues.Expected: Error identifies SKU-DRILL-100 and no outbound ledger is saved
semanticValues.Exception: BusinessException: No stock found for SKU-DRILL-100
